main_text.p: צלם צַלְמָא Ch. Imago, Statua. Sic & Syr. Matth. 22. 20. Plur. צַלְמַיָּא, צַלְמִין.
צַלְמָן Ch. Idem. Plur. emphat. צַלְמַנָּיָא, Genef. 31. 19.
צלף Syr. Contundere, percutere, vulnerare, Marc. 5. 5. & 12. 4. Ex Aphel Futur. Ch. יִצְלֵף, Contundet, Psal. 74. 5.
צלק צוּלְקָא צַלְקָא Ch. Adustio, inflammatio: Cicatrix, צוּלְקַת שִׁיחָנָא Cicatrix adustionis, Hebr. צָרֶבֶת, Levit. 13. 23. in Jon. & Exod. 2. 5. in eod.
צמא צְמֵי Ch. Abscindere, praecidere, וְתִצְמֵי־ית טוּפְרֵיהָא Et praecidet ungues suos, Deut. 21. 12. Jon.
צמר Ch. Ligare, alligare: obligare vulnus, Ezech. 34. 4. 16. Partic. Pehil צְמִיר Ligatus, colligatus, copulatus. Plur. צְמִידִין.
צמח Ch. Pullulare, germinare, efflorescere, reflorescere, provenire, oriri, exoriri. Pahel צַמַּח Idem. Aphel אַצְמַח Germinare facere, producere.
צמחא, צמח Chald. Germen. Syr. ܙܰܡܰܚܳܐ Germen gloriae ejus, ad Hebr. 1. 2. id est, Splendor. Vide notas Tremellii. Plur. צְמָחִין, צְמָחַיָּא Germina.
צמחוני צְמָחוֹנֵי Ch. Germinantia, pullulantia, virentia, Deuter. 32. 2. in Jon.
צמם צְמָצֵם Ch. Tegere, obtegere, operire, Genef. 38. 15. in Targ. Hierosol. Ithpahel וְאִתְצְמַצַּם Et operiebat se, Genef. 24. 65. in T. Hierof.
צמק Aruit, exaruit, Hebr. Hinc in Targ. Partic. Pehil צְמִיק Aridus. Plur. עִנְבִין צְמִיקִין Uvae aridae, passae, Num. 6. 3. in T. Jon.

page.notes: Hebrew and Chaldee forms are reproduced as far as legible; the Syriac and some vowel pointing in the scan are doubtful and may differ from the print. The Syriac word after "Syr." and the Hebrew in the first line are partly illegible at this resolution.
